references.text: Deals with evil and idolatry that arise in the cities the Lord has given, and how this is to be investigated and punished.
Describes wicked men (בְּנֵי־בְלִיַּעַל) who lead the people into sin, using the same expression as in verse 14.
Eli's sons are described as wicked men (בְּנֵי בְלִיָּעַל) who did not know the Lord.
Wicked men (בְּנֵי בְלִיַּעַל) give false testimony against Naboth, an example of evil in one of Israel's cities.
Warning against following other gods in the land the Lord gives them to live in.
Warning that some in the cities may turn away and worship other gods.
Paul uses the term Belial (from בְּלִיַּעַל) as a contrast to Christ, warning against fellowship with unbelievers.
